title: Compile one rational compact-time shear for the entire H3 input ball
statement: For every rational nu>0,K>=1, set C*=2^30,R=ceil(100C*(1+K/nu)), eps=min(1/4,nu/(100C*K)),q=10(R+1),m=(1,q,q^2),n=(1,q^3,q^6),a=m cross n. Low integer k with0<|k|<=R have a.k and m.k nonzero. Set r=1/(R^2|m|^2),A=sum|a_i|,s=ceil(10^9*r^-7*eps^-5), N=ceil(100C*(1+R+s*A*R^2/eps+K*(1+s*A)/nu)),p=Nm,H=C*(1+s*A*(1+sum|p_i|)^3),Q0=2^(2H),M0=2KQ0,E=nu*M0+C*M0^2,D=ceil(10^3*(1+C*KQ0+2M0*E^2/nu^3)),delta=1/D. With h(z)=140z^3(1-z)^3, b(t,x)=s*D*h(Dt)*a*cos(2pi*p.x) on[0,delta], zero otherwise. It is prescribed, divergence-free and globally C2. Output M=2^1000*M0 and T=delta+(1+64K^2*M/nu^3)/nu. All finite rational/integer descriptions are independent of the initial profile.
